rotp_sws.configuration.title: RotP Spawn With Stand Configuration
RotP Spawn With Stand Common Settings
rotp_sws.configuration.standChance.toolt: Chance (0-100%%) to get a stand upon first joining a world (Default: 13.0)
rotp_sws.configuration.useStandOrder.too: If true, stands are given in the order specified in standOrder. If false, eligible stands are selected randomly.
rotp_sws.configuration.standOrder.toolti: Ordered Stand IDs for successful first-login rolls, for example ["jojo_ripples:the_world", "rotp_kingcrimson:kingcrimson"]. After the list is exhausted, selection is random. An invalid entry consumes its ordered slot without a fallback.
